name: MCPMark
intro: MCPMark是一个旨在评估大语言模型（LLMs）与外部系统交互能力的基准测试。它由127个高质量任务组成，这些任务由领域专家和AI智能体共同创建，每个任务都包含一个初始状态和自动验证脚本。MCPMark通过模拟真实世界的工作流程，要求LLMs进行更丰富和多样化的环境交互，涉及广泛的创建、读取、更新和删除（CRUD）操作，以全面评估LLMs作为通用智能体的能力。
org: NUS TRAIL, EvalSys, LobeHub, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Fudan University
build_method: 人机协作构建, 专家与社区验证
eval_feature: 多轮, 状态跟踪, 程序化验证
build_method_en: Human-AI Co-design, Expert and Community Validation
intro_en: MCPMark is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' (LLMs) ability to interact with external systems. It consists of 127 high-quality tasks co-created by domain experts and AI agents, each featuring an initial state and an automated verification script. By simulating real-world workflows, MCPMark requires LLMs to perform richer and more diverse environment interactions, covering a wide range of create, read, update, and delete (CRUD) operations, to comprehensively assess LLMs' capabilities as general-purpose agents.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2509.24002, Sections 2.1-2.3, 3.1, and Appendix A. The paper curates 38 initial states for Filesystem, Notion, Playwright, GitHub, and PostgreSQL; pairs experts with task-creation and task-execution agents in exploration, evolvement, verification, and iteration stages; tests verifier success and failure behavior; assembles 127 CRUD-diverse instruction-state-verifier tasks; applies expert cross-review, a month-long community check, and additional review of tasks solved by no model; runs a state-tracked sandbox lifecycle with programmatic verification and reset; and reports pass@1, pass@4, and pass^4 from four independent runs.
